channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from PNallDR, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Rep. Jordan: Sanctuary Policies Now Affect Nearly a Third of the Country
item.description: Rep. Jim Jordan, R-Ohio, said on Newsmax that Democratic sanctuary policies now impact almost a third of the nation.

item.title: DHS Secretary Criticizes New York Leaders After Major Arrest Operation
item.description: DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin announced over 2,100 arrests in New York and criticized the state's sanctuary policies.

item.title: ActBlue Leader Invokes Fifth Amendment in Foreign Donations Probe
item.description: Kimberly Peeler-Allen, an ActBlue board member, pleaded the Fifth during a House investigation into alleged foreign donations.

item.title: Putin Supports Iran as Trump Intensifies Strikes and Sanctions
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin reaffirmed support for Iran as the U.S. launched new strikes against Iranian targets.
